pos.caption: A person rolls out a large, flat piece of dough on a wooden surface using a wooden rolling pin, ensuring the dough becomes thinner and more even in texture.
A person uses a pastry wheel to cut a large, flat sheet of dough into triangular shapes on a floured wooden surface, with the cut edges forming a zigzag pattern.

A person meticulously seals a dumpling filled with a mixture of green vegetables and possibly meat, using their fingers to pinch the edges together. Several uncooked dumpling wrappers and a dusting of flour are scattered on the wooden table surface.

neg.caption: Four individuals, dressed in warm, casual attire including jackets and hoodies, walk together along a paved pathway lined with trees and a glass-enclosed structure, engaging in conversation and laughter as they move forward.

A modern, loft-style office features exposed brick walls and industrial lighting. A woman in glasses, a pink jacket, and blue jeans stands confidently at the front of a room, gesturing as she speaks to a group of four casually dressed individuals seated on the floor, who are attentively listening and smiling.

A diverse group of five professionals, including two women wearing hijabs, a man with glasses, and a blonde woman in a light blue blazer, are gathered closely around a laptop on a table, engaging in a collaborative discussion. The blonde woman points at the screen while the others attentively observe and contribute to the conversation.

pos.caption: Rolling hills blanketed with vibrant yellow wildflowers, interspersed with patches of purple blooms, stretch under a clear blue sky. Winding roads cut through the landscape, and distant mountains add depth to the serene natural scenery.

A breathtaking aerial scene reveals a rugged, mountainous landscape with a diverse palette of earthy tones, featuring undulating hills and valleys interspersed with patches of green vegetation, winding streams, and distant snow-capped peaks under a partly cloudy sky.

A serene landscape features lush green hills with vibrant yellow patches, calm turquoise waters that mirror the sky and clouds, and distant mountains under a partly cloudy blue sky, creating a harmonious blend of natural beauty.

neg.caption: A dimly lit gym features exposed brick walls and various exercise equipment in the background. A woman dressed in athletic wear performs a box jump onto a wooden box. A shirtless man wearing black shorts stands nearby, observing her with his hands at his sides.
A man lies on his back on a bed, laughing heartily with his mouth wide open, while another person, partially visible and wearing dark shorts, playfully wrestles or tickles him from above.

A young child, wearing a dark blue shirt and denim shorts, playfully wrestles with an adult lying on their back on a light wooden floor. Both laugh as the child straddles the adult's chest and then shifts to hug them tightly. In the background, another person sits on a white rug with legs crossed, holding a smartphone.

pos.caption: A vibrant urban skate park adorned with graffiti features a skateboarder executing a precise grind on a concrete ledge. Spectators and other skaters watch from various vantage points under a clear sky.

A skateboarder, dressed in a dark hoodie and jeans, skillfully performs a trick by launching off a ramp in an indoor space adorned with vibrant graffiti on the walls and columns, landing smoothly back on the board as they continue their dynamic ride through the urban setting.

A group of people, including a skateboarder in the foreground and others on bicycles further back, move along a paved path at sunset. The sun casts long shadows and a warm glow. Tall residential buildings and a busy street with cars line the left side of the scene.

neg.caption: A young man with red hair and a matching beard, wearing a light pink t-shirt, stands against a solid blue background. He initially faces to the left with a neutral expression, then turns his head slightly forward while opening his mouth as if speaking or reacting.
A man with a contemplative expression, wearing a white shirt, gently touches his face with his fingers while looking downward, suggesting deep thought or concern.

A person with short, tousled brown hair and wearing large, round, tortoiseshell glasses holds a pencil above their head with their right hand, looking to the side with a thoughtful expression while slightly tilting their head.

pos.caption: A person wearing glasses uses a hammer to secure or adjust a wooden handle, holding it firmly with their other hand in a focused and precise manner.

A brightly lit room is filled with cardboard boxes. A man in a gray hoodie and black pants kneels on the floor, assembling a small white table with black legs. A woman in a white shirt and light-colored pants sits beside him, holding a plastic bag of screws and bolts. Both appear focused on their task. Large windows with gray curtains and an open door frame the scene.

A woman, wearing a white knitted sweater, assists a young child dressed in a pink outfit as they sit at a wooden dining table. The woman gently guides the child's hands, which hold a knife and fork, to cut into a piece of food on a white plate that also contains slices of apple. A yellow bowl with a wooden spoon and another white bowl are placed nearby on the table.

neg.caption: A dynamic, abstract 3D object composed of intertwined metallic and fiery elements continuously morphs and rotates against a stark black background, with glowing orange and red molten sections that appear to be melting or burning through the structure, creating an intense and fluid visual effect.

A close-up of a chameleon's head reveals its intricate eye structure, featuring a prominent, independently moving eye with vivid green and brown coloration. The eye is surrounded by detailed scales in various shades of green, yellow, and brown, all set against a softly blurred natural background.
A mesmerizing display of glowing yellow-orange blobs floats and merges within a vibrant red liquid, creating a dynamic and fluid motion that resembles the behavior of wax in a lava lamp.
